description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeNumber that extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable. It adds a condition to a query builder based on employee number, retrieves employee data, and formats it as an array.

classes.name: EmployeeNumber
classes.description: A class for filtering employees by employee number within report filters, capable of modifying query builder objects and providing array representations of employee data.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a where condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and a value X is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the alias 'employee' for use in queries.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Fetches employee details by employee number and returns an array with id, label, and active status, or null if employee not found.
